dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Oh Archons, are there still any more strange fees I haven't paid yet? Are there!? Come at me then, you fiends!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...I'm not here to collect any fees.

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: R—Really? Wh—Whoa, that's a relief...

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, friend. I just got a little worked up, but can you blame me? Two days ago, I was charged with some "road-clearing tax" for passing through a small alley...

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: And then came the "water tax," the "machine-operating tax," and the all-new "door-opening tax"... It's a circus out here, but I'm too scared to laugh. What if there's a "laughter tax" on top of everything else?

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: In this place, you can never guess what they're going to tax you for next... It's just bizarre.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm here to collect your "right to exist tax."

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: My "right to exist tax"...? Wait a minute, surely this one's a bit too much to ask for, right?

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Which means you're... joking! Right? Right...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to scare you.

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Oh, thank the seas! I thought you were here to collect taxes... L—Let me just flip through the regulations again... Why *are* there so many strange taxes? Wait. Have I been falling for scams?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Lady Nefer, I was just about to seek you out. Can your Curatorium of Secrets help me with my taxes?

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: *sigh* This tax form is such a mess — I really can't get my head around it...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Of course, we can. If you need help, just drop by later on.

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Uhm... And, uh, do you charge an "intelligence tax"?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: The intelligence tax is already included in your fee.

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Hah! So considerate... Oh, you're pulling my leg, aren't you? That was a joke, wasn't it...?

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Whew, I won! Wait a second, there's no "victory tax," right?

dialogues.speaker: Berain
dialogues.text: Guess I've lost. Mm... And, uh, there's no "failure tax" I should be aware of, right?
